R1.evidence: No docker-compose, no tests/test.sh, no solution/solve.sh in the clone (find . -name test.sh -o -name solve.sh => none; no environment/ dir). nop/oracle unmeasurable. Two-container images exist (logfire-gateway, logfire-agent) but no Harbor wiring/healthcheck/depends_on.

R2.evidence: Gateway shipped as per-incident COPY-data image logfire-gateway:oddish-incident-534pm; no :prod-v1/:empty pair (buildx imagetools inspect :prod-v1 and :empty => not found on GHCR). Both images linux/amd64-only (docker image inspect => linux/amd64). Agent carries gateway API source /opt/logfire_clone/server.py (not stripped). Baked-DB mechanism works (incident gateway boots mount-free, serves 3292 records) but not as the prod-v1 contract.

R3.evidence: CLI (logfire {query,exceptions,schema}) and MCP (arbitrary_query, find_exceptions, get_logfire_records_schema) both listed and called live. Both are thin clients of POST /v2/query via cli.query (no business logic in either). Parity verified: CLI `exceptions --limit 2` == MCP `find_exceptions {limit:2}` => EQUAL (byte-equal data).

R4.evidence: No docs/COVERAGE.md exists (R4.1). Envelope fidelity itself is good: {schema:{fields:[{name,data_type}]},data:[...]} verified on /v2/query; real error envelopes (401 {detail}, 400 {error,details}, 404). But the required machine-checkable coverage matrix is absent.

R5.evidence: Small clone (>=3 bar). arbitrary_query and find_exceptions each satisfy >=3 of {stateful-read, multi-step, realistic errors, query grammar, devops-investigation shape}. DuckDB SQL query grammar over records (GROUP BY, time-window scoping) verified live = T2 discriminating surface. R5.2 write-read round-trip is N/A (read-only clone, no bundled task) — replaced by read-investigation chain; acceptable for a read-only telemetry API but no bundled task demonstrates it.

R6.evidence: No tests/ directory at all in the clone (find . -path tests => none). Zero coverage of endpoints/CLI/MCP; no parity test; no isolation test.
